thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 01/04/2019: SQ, QCOM, AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL, IBM, CSCO, MSFT

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 01/04/2019: SQ, QCOM, AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL, IBM, CSCO, MSFT
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +1.33%
AAPL: +1.32%
IBM: Flat
CSCO: +1.36%
GOOG: +1.27%
Tech stocks were higher in Pre-bell trading Friday.
Early movers include:
(+) Square ( SQ ), which was gaining more than 2% in value. The company said Friday that Amrita Ahuja will join the company as CFO this month, reporting to CEO Jack Dorsey.
In other sector news:
(+) Qualcomm ( QCOM ) has asked a German court to enforce an order to ban the sale of Apple's (APPL) iPhones in the country amid a protracted patent dispute, media reported. Both Qualcomm and Apple were more than 1% higher early Friday.
(+) Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) was up over 1% as its life sciences company Verily raised $1 billion in a funding round led by technology investment firm Silver Lake.
